Competition Experience

Coaching Experience

3+ years of Muay Thai coaching at CMA Youth Program Assistant Director

Eric started training Muay Thai as a teenager over a decade ago with Coach Joe. After developing his skill and passion, he joined the fight team and began competing locally. He has since transitioned to coaching beginner and intermediate adults and children, helping them to find love in the sport the same way he did. He also enjoys providing direct one-on-one private training to students.
